ms_abilene.note: Correct demand to two 336 MW IT buildings. The 900 MW figure is plant nameplate, not electrical load. Site OEM allocation is unresolved; portfolio turbine orders may cover it and cannot be assigned wholesale.

frontier.note: Full design is 1.4 GW IT; first customer 1H27 is not full-campus delivery. Credit Oracle's 115 MW available power. Oracle and Vantage have multi-site VoltaGrid agreements; site allocation remains unresolved.
frontier.creditType: Primary company disclosure of available power

claude.note: 900 MW capacity basis and first service date unresolved. Direct wind connections do not establish firm 24-hour coverage or an open turbine procurement.

crusoe_childress.note: 1 GW ERCOT-approved interconnect, but first customer-ready date not disclosed. Excluded for missing horizon, not proof that electricity is already available.

abilene_original.note: Credit at least200 MW of electricity for the two100 MW buildings described as energized by Crusoe. Site-wide grid/equipment allocation remains unreconciled; 42% tenant delivery is not multiplied by1.2 GW electrical scope.
abilene_original.creditType: Minimum electricity for two100 MW energized buildings

lighthouse.note: We Energies selected. Exact supply agreement MW not reviewed; no numeric supply credit is not evidence the utility agreement is absent. Transmission completeness revoked September10; bridge fraction/duration unverified.

saline.note: Primary Supply Agreement covers approximately 1.4 GW. Credit contractual allocation; actual monthly readiness and appeal risks remain separate. The separate 1.4 GW battery proposal is not additional generation.

jupiter.note: Bloom fuel-cell design selected, replacing turbine/diesel design. Site customer load MW not quantified in selected primary material; no numerical open gap.

milam.note: Correct missing capacity: SB Energy now lists ~750 MW. MW definition and phase size unresolved. Project site verifies first operations in 2027. Held out for basis, not no demand.

cheyenne.note: April generation procurement agreement and over $200m customer contributions show supply procurement. Equipment MW unquantified; full 1.8 GW ceiling is an information gap, not an uncontracted order.

iren_sw1.note: May1 substation energization verified. 1.4 GW capacity arranged but delivery ramps with construction. Full current operating load is not 1.4 GW.
iren_sw1.creditType: Secured grid capacity; energized substation, phased delivery

iren_sw2.note: 600 MW secured grid capacity, historical late2027 target. Contractual allocation credit; full dated service ramp not verified.

iren_childress.note: 750 MW grid-connected campus; AI deployment is separately phased. GPU-service contracts do not represent electricity procurement.

kiowa.note: IREN 10-Q explicitly identifies 1,600 MW contractual Oklahoma power rights. Power ramps from2028; full 1.6 GW on-time service remains unverified.

river_bend.note: Initial 330 MW utility capacity secured with Entergy supports 245 MW IT. Use stated gross capacity rather than a generic PUE. 1,000 MW expansion requires more power and is excluded.
river_bend.creditType: Company-reported secured initial Entergy utility capacity

beacon.note: 1,000 MW utility design/approvals for two phases. Interconnection approvals and prefunding do not independently document a quantified executed power-supply contract. Larger ceiling is not proven open demand.

pf1.note: 400 MW IT lease is customer demand, not an electricity contract. 100 MW IT operating proves at least100 MW electric service; unquantified partially operating second building omitted from credit. Portfolio grid capacity not site allocated.
pf1.creditType: Minimum electricity inferred from 100 MW IT operating

pf2.note: 200 MW IT lease and power-backed portfolio. Company says land and/or executed utility agreements; exact site supply allocation not reconciled. No numeric credit does not mean no contract.

df1.note: Use published430 MW gross campus scope; 300 MW IT is same site. Portfolio grid capacity does not resolve exact campus supply contract MW.

df2.note: 210 MW IT, first service2028. Applied Digital's2.15 GW portfolio includes five campuses; exact campus supply allocation unresolved.

lake_mariner.note: 438 MW IT contracted,102 MW IT operating. Credit102 MW minimum electrical service. Grid strategy may cover the remaining campus; no numeric credit for future full-scope supply without reconciliation.
lake_mariner.creditType: Minimum electricity inferred from102 MW IT operating

justified.note: August approval verifies a482 MW Retail Electric Service Agreement supporting401 MW IT. Full delivery targeted early2028; not proof of current operating capacity.

muskie.note: October5 amended agreement:500 MW first phase ramps2028; second500 MW in2029. Cap this through2028 scope at500 MW. Later contract delivery is not automatically a bridge gap without an earlier tenant need.

abernathy.note: 168 MW IT lease, power-controlled site and ownership sale. Utility supply contract volume unresolved; do not count JV sale as a new campus.

barber.note: 300 MW interconnect and publisher energized status support existing supply. Actual leased IT may be smaller; current tenant conversion does not create another300 MW open pool.

black_pearl.note: 300 MW approved/energized campus. AWS IT acceptance is a separate stage; do not create an uncovered pool simply because conversion continues.

colchis.note: Executed1 GW AEP connection agreement; current target2028-29. Credit contractual allocation, not full on-time2028 electricity.

ulysses.note: 200 MW secured AEP Ohio capacity, Q4 2027 target. Arrangement is stronger than an unallocated power strategy, but current electricity delivery not verified.

fermi.note: 17 GW is multi-decade generation ambition, not matched2028 tenant load. Excluded for wrong capacity basis, not assumed covered.

homer.note: 4.5 GW generation plant with GE equipment selected. No matched tenant load-by2028; do not add generation rating to IT demand.

meta_hyperion.note: Entergy plants targeted late2028/2029; site-specific load ramp not extracted. Plant MW do not establish an equally sized uncovered customer load.

meta_elpaso.note: SEC filing verifies366 MW ERock bridge generation with generator purchase agreement, mid2027 target and multi-year bridge use. Count once: same366 MW project appears in two case studies. 1 GW compute basis and phases unresolved; no1 GW-minus366 MW shortage claim.

meta_lebanon.note: 1 GW headline capacity; IT/electrical basis and first service unresolved. No numeric by2028 gap.

meta_tulsa.note: Campus exists; site MW and power-ready date unavailable. State renewable procurement is not campus demand.

aws_richmond.note: 57 Duke non-emergency bridge engines demonstrate a bridge need; already selected. MW unquantified;588 AWS emergency engines are separate. Not added to366 MW bridge subtotal.

aws_salem.note: Site named in AWS statewide announcement; no site-specific load/phase. Nuclear adjacency not proof of all phases covered.

aws_falls.note: Campus named; no primary numeric load in reviewed source. Secondary600 MW claim not used; unknown gap not zero.

aws_carlisle.note: Existing Rainier campus confirmed. New2.4 GW Northern Indiana program is not allocated to this record, so no guessed site MW.

aws_madison.note: County program groups two campuses; allocated MW unresolved. Statewide investment/utility plans do not establish site coverage.

aws_warren.note: Separate county campus, no primary numeric power need or matched supply volume. Unresolved, not zero demand.

aws_hinds.note: Delphi conversion confirmed; no MW or service schedule. Capex is not electrical load.

google_mn.note: Xcel agreement selects utility supply; no site-load MW. Wind/solar/storage not summed into firm demand or supply.

google_muskogee.note: Named Google campus; no load MW or service schedule. Not the unrelated similarly named crypto facility.

google_stillwater.note: Named Google campus; load and power-ready date unavailable. No zero-gap inference.

ms_wisconsin.note: Grouped existing Fairwater/expansion. Prepayment and WE Energies strategy disclosed; no numeric site load in selected page.

ms_laporte.note: Construction/grading confirmed. Load MW and first service missing; no numeric bridge interval.

rowan_temple.note: Oncor power secured for300 MW headline campus; IT versus electric basis unresolved. Excluded from electrical sum, not assumed open.
